intent: Metric 4: unit tests for the release-day comparison and headline (exact fixtures)

edits.new_content:
version: 2
models:
- name: fct_github_release_day_activities
  description: 'Metric 4 breakdown: release day against the median of the same weekday in the weeks before
    it (canonical: the Thursday before), one row per activity.'
  config:
    meta:
      dex:
        grain:
        - activity
        population:
          rule: One row per activity present in fct_github_daily, whether or not release day has been
            counted yet.
        assumptions:
        - decision: What release day is compared with
          chosen: the same weekday a week before (Thu 12 Nov 2026); a median when github_baseline_weeks
            > 1
          evidence: data
          detail: 'profiled (.dex/review/154): strong weekly cycle, and PRs opened grew from 1.15M (22
            Oct) to 1.35M (12 Nov) on Thursdays, so older weeks understate a normal 19 Nov; commits carry
            bulk-import spikes (16.4M on 5 Nov vs ~12.9M), hence a median for longer baselines. No US
            holiday on 12 Nov'
          column: baseline_count
        - decision: A baseline day without a count
          chosen: change NULL
          evidence: default
          detail: an average over fewer days would be a different baseline
          column: pct_change
  columns:
  - name: activity
    description: prs_opened, prs_merged or commits.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: key
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: activity_label
    description: PRs opened, PRs merged or Commits.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: release_day
    description: GTA 6's release day (var github_release_day).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: time
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: baseline_weeks
    description: How many same weekdays before release day form the baseline.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: baseline_start
    description: First baseline day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: baseline_end
    description: Last baseline day (a week before release day).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: baseline_days_found
    description: Baseline days with a count.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: never
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: days
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: baseline_count
    description: Median count over the baseline days (the day itself when there is one).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: NULL when no baseline day has a count.
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: count
  - name: release_day_count
    description: Count on release day. NULL until the day is over and counted.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: NULL until release day has ended and been counted.
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: count
  - name: pct_change
    description: Release day against the baseline average, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: NULL unless release day and every baseline day have a count.
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: percent
unit_tests:
- name: github_release_day_vs_the_thursday_before
  description: Release day against the same weekday a week before; other days and weekdays are ignored
    (a busy Wednesday must not move the baseline).
  model: fct_github_release_day_activities
  overrides:
    vars:
      github_release_day: '2026-11-19'
      github_baseline_weeks: 1
  given:
  - input: ref('fct_github_daily')
    rows:
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      activity_date: '2026-11-19'
      activity_count: 750
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      activity_date: '2026-11-12'
      activity_count: 1000
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      activity_date: '2026-11-18'
      activity_count: 5000
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      activity_date: '2026-11-05'
      activity_count: 9000
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      activity_date: '2026-11-20'
      activity_count: 7000
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      activity_date: '2026-11-13'
      activity_count: 3000
  expect:
    rows:
    - activity: prs_opened
      baseline_start: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_end: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_days_found: 1
      baseline_count: 1000
      release_day_count: 750
      pct_change: -25.0
- name: github_release_day_not_counted_yet_is_null
  description: Before release day has been counted the change is NULL, never -100%.
  model: fct_github_release_day_activities
  overrides:
    vars:
      github_release_day: '2026-11-19'
      github_baseline_weeks: 1
  given:
  - input: ref('fct_github_daily')
    rows:
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      activity_date: '2026-11-12'
      activity_count: 1000
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      activity_date: '2026-11-19'
      activity_count: null
  expect:
    rows:
    - activity: prs_opened
      baseline_count: 1000
      release_day_count: null
      pct_change: null
- name: github_longer_baseline_is_a_median_of_same_weekdays
  description: 'Three weeks back: the median of the three Thursdays, so one bulk-import spike (9000) does
    not move it; the Thursday four weeks back is outside.'
  model: fct_github_release_day_activities
  overrides:
    vars:
      github_release_day: '2026-11-19'
      github_baseline_weeks: 3
  given:
  - input: ref('fct_github_daily')
    rows:
    - activity: commits
      activity_label: Commits
      activity_date: '2026-11-19'
      activity_count: 1250
    - activity: commits
      activity_label: Commits
      activity_date: '2026-11-12'
      activity_count: 1000
    - activity: commits
      activity_label: Commits
      activity_date: '2026-11-05'
      activity_count: 9000
    - activity: commits
      activity_label: Commits
      activity_date: '2026-10-29'
      activity_count: 800
    - activity: commits
      activity_label: Commits
      activity_date: '2026-10-22'
      activity_count: 1
    - activity: commits
      activity_label: Commits
      activity_date: '2026-11-11'
      activity_count: 50
  expect:
    rows:
    - activity: commits
      baseline_start: '2026-10-29'
      baseline_end: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_days_found: 3
      baseline_count: 1000
      release_day_count: 1250
      pct_change: 25.0
- name: github_missing_baseline_day_leaves_change_null
  description: A baseline Thursday without a count makes the change NULL.
  model: fct_github_release_day_activities
  overrides:
    vars:
      github_release_day: '2026-11-19'
      github_baseline_weeks: 2
  given:
  - input: ref('fct_github_daily')
    rows:
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      activity_date: '2026-11-19'
      activity_count: 1100
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      activity_date: '2026-11-12'
      activity_count: 1000
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      activity_date: '2026-11-05'
      activity_count: null
  expect:
    rows:
    - activity: prs_opened
      baseline_days_found: 1
      pct_change: null

version: 2
models:
- name: fct_github_release_day
  description: 'Metric 4 headline: the average of the activities'' release-day changes, one row per release
    day, with its breakdown.'
  config:
    meta:
      dex:
        grain:
        - release_day_key
        population:
          rule: One row for the configured release day (var github_release_day).
        assumptions:
        - decision: How the activities combine
          chosen: plain average of the per-activity percent changes
          evidence: precedent
          detail: the Day-Off Index averages its phrases' changes the same way; counts differ by 10x between
            PRs and commits, so changes are averaged, not counts
          column: github_release_day_change
        - decision: An activity not yet available
          chosen: headline NULL
          evidence: precedent
          detail: 'fct_day_off_index: an average over fewer parts is a different number'
          column: github_release_day_change
  columns:
  - name: release_day_key
    description: 'Release day as text: the row''s key.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: key
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: release_day
    description: GTA 6's release day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: time
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: baseline_start
    description: First baseline day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: baseline_end
    description: Last baseline day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: baseline_weeks
    description: Baseline days (same weekday, weeks before).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: activities_total
    description: Activities in the breakdown.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: never
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: count
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: activities_available
    description: Activities with a change.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: never
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: count
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: github_release_day_change
    description: Average of the activities' changes, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: NULL until every activity has a change.
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: percent
  - name: breakdown
    description: Every activity's change. Always report it with the headline.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
unit_tests:
- name: github_headline_is_the_average_of_changes
  description: The headline averages the activities' changes and spells each out.
  model: fct_github_release_day
  given:
  - input: ref('fct_github_release_day_activities')
    rows:
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      release_day: '2026-11-19'
      baseline_start: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_end: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_weeks: 1
      pct_change: -10.0
    - activity: prs_merged
      activity_label: PRs merged
      release_day: '2026-11-19'
      baseline_start: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_end: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_weeks: 1
      pct_change: -5.0
    - activity: commits
      activity_label: Commits
      release_day: '2026-11-19'
      baseline_start: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_end: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_weeks: 1
      pct_change: 3.0
  expect:
    rows:
    - release_day_key: '2026-11-19'
      activities_total: 3
      activities_available: 3
      github_release_day_change: -4.0
      breakdown: PRs opened -10.0% · PRs merged -5.0% · Commits +3.0%
- name: github_headline_null_until_every_activity_counted
  description: One activity without a change leaves the headline NULL.
  model: fct_github_release_day
  given:
  - input: ref('fct_github_release_day_activities')
    rows:
    - activity: prs_opened
      activity_label: PRs opened
      release_day: '2026-11-19'
      baseline_start: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_end: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_weeks: 1
      pct_change: -10.0
    - activity: commits
      activity_label: Commits
      release_day: '2026-11-19'
      baseline_start: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_end: '2026-11-12'
      baseline_weeks: 1
      pct_change: null
  expect:
    rows:
    - activities_available: 1
      github_release_day_change: null
      breakdown: PRs opened -10.0% · Commits not yet available
